meta: A chatbot that answers customers in the language they write in, with native-quality checks. From $100, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: Multi-language replies in your customers' language
overview: If customers write to you in several languages, the chatbot should reply in each one without extra staff. We set it to detect the language, answer from your content in that language and keep names, prices and policy terms accurate. We test the most important questions in every language, and flag translations a native speaker should review before launch.

faq: Most major languages, including Spanish, French, German, Portuguese, Italian, Arabic, Chinese, Japanese and Hindi. Quality varies by language, so we test and tell you where a native check is wise.
Will it translate my whole help content?
It answers from your content in the customer's language on the spot. For the best accuracy, we can translate key answers ahead of time so a person can approve them.
How do you keep prices and policies correct?
Terms, prices and names live in a glossary the assistant must follow. We test that these stay exact in every language, especially anything related to money or returns.
Can staff who read only one language take handoffs?
Yes. A handed-off chat can include a translation for your team, with the original text beside it, so staff can reply with confidence or ask a speaker to check.
